name: matrix-broadcasting-residual-shape-guard
explain: Demonstrates how 2D column predictions [B, 1] subtracted from 1D targets [B] silently broadcast into [B, B] outer difference matrices instead of per-example residuals, and enforces shape assertion guards.
steps: Construct 1D target and 2D column prediction tensors || Trace silent outer product broadcasting on unaligned subtraction || Enforce explicit squeeze and shape assertions to guarantee 1D residual vector.
expect: All matrix broadcasting residual shape assertions verified successfully.
limit: Tests broadcasting semantics on tensor shapes; does not perform full model backward passes.

name: dot-product-vs-cosine-similarity-norm
explain: Demonstrates ranking inversions between raw dot product and cosine similarity caused by vector magnitude dominance, and validates L2 unit normalization equivalence.
steps: Construct orthogonal, aligned, and large unaligned candidate vectors || Compute raw dot product vs cosine similarity rankings to expose magnitude dominance || Apply L2 unit normalization and verify monotonic equivalence between dot product and cosine score.
expect: All dot product vs cosine similarity assertions verified successfully.
limit: Evaluates pairwise geometric metrics on static vector fixtures; does not simulate HNSW graph index search.

name: base-rate-fallacy-bayes-precision
explain: Demonstrates the base-rate fallacy where a 90% sensitive and 99% specific classifier yields only 47.62% precision on a 1% rare event population, and verifies Bayes theorem posterior probability calculation.
steps: Construct 2x2 contingency table for 10,000 population at 1% prevalence || Calculate true positives, false positives, sensitivity, specificity, and positive predictive value || Apply Bayes theorem and demonstrate posterior collapse when prevalence drops from 1% to 0.1%.
expect: All base-rate fallacy Bayes precision assertions verified successfully.
limit: Calculates exact discrete Bayesian posteriors; does not train classifier threshold models.

name: clustered-correlation-variance-estimator
explain: Demonstrates how intra-cluster correlation from near-duplicate synthetic benchmark questions deflates standard errors, and calculates clustered variance inflation factor (VIF) and effective sample size.
steps: Generate clustered evaluation benchmark queries with intra-cluster correlation rho || Calculate standard i.i.d. variance and naive confidence interval || Apply clustered Huber-White sandwich estimator and calculate Variance Inflation Factor 1 + (m-1)*rho to compute honest confidence intervals.
expect: All clustered correlation variance estimator assertions verified successfully.
limit: Computes cluster-robust variance on synthetic score distributions; does not evaluate generative LLM answers.

name: squared-error-loss-mean-gradient-parity
explain: Demonstrates analytical chain rule gradient derivation of mean MSE vs sum MSE, verifies gradient parity against two-sided finite difference approximations, and prevents batch-size dependent gradient scaling bugs.
steps: Implement scalar linear model forward pass for single sample and mini-batch || Derive analytical chain-rule gradients for both mean MSE and sum MSE || Validate gradient implementation against two-sided central difference approximation.
expect: All squared error loss mean gradient parity assertions verified successfully.
limit: Tests scalar and 1D vector linear regression gradients; does not evaluate deep neural network backprop.

name: numerically-stable-softmax-logsumexp
explain: Demonstrates IEEE 754 floating-point overflow on large logits, proves shift invariance, and validates numerically stable softmax and LogSumExp implementations.
steps: Evaluate naive softmax on extreme logits [1000, 1001] to trigger float inf and NaN division || Implement shift-invariant softmax subtracting max(z) and verify output [0.268941, 0.731059] || Validate LogSumExp numerical stability on extreme negative and positive logit ranges.
expect: All numerically stable softmax LogSumExp assertions verified successfully.
limit: Evaluates numerical stability on 1D logit distributions; does not execute GPU kernel fusions.

name: unsupervised-pca-leakage-cross-validation
explain: Demonstrates data leakage when unsupervised PCA dimensionality reduction is fit on the full dataset before cross-validation, and implements strictly isolated fold-level fit and transform pipelines.
steps: Construct synthetic dataset with known latent components || Fit PCA on entire dataset before train/val split to expose data leakage of validation variance and mean || Implement strict fold-level transform isolating fit to training split only.
expect: All unsupervised PCA leakage cross-validation assertions verified successfully.
limit: Simulates SVD/PCA dimensionality reduction on tabular matrices; does not perform streaming incremental PCA.

name: wilson-score-confidence-interval
explain: Demonstrates the failure of Wald normal approximation confidence intervals on extreme binomial proportions (producing upper bounds > 1.0) and validates asymmetric Wilson score intervals bounded in [0, 1].
steps: Calculate naive Wald interval for 98 successes out of 100 benchmark queries, proving upper bound exceeds 1.0 || Implement asymmetric Wilson score interval with continuity bounds || Verify honest Wilson confidence interval [0.9300, 0.9945] on 98/100 and non-zero uncertainty on 100/100.
expect: All Wilson score confidence interval assertions verified successfully.
limit: Computes exact binomial confidence intervals; does not calibrate Bayesian Beta-Binomial posteriors.
